stationary_configuration.outcome: Stationary primary: arithmetic mean of individual exact-covariance true_ratio_db at t=T=200. Measured heldout power remains the parameter-selection criterion. Moving records retain their original episode-averaged ratio definitions.
stationary_configuration.repetition_unit: Independent episode. Held-out snapshots average inside a checkpoint; moving primary outcomes average checkpoints inside the episode.
stationary_configuration.selection: Independent held-out measured disturbance power on disjoint validation episodes only; no true signature, covariance, oracle power or drift enters policy selection. Static beta=1. Moving mean/mode/isotropic share a mode-selected beta. Modal loading and loaded covariance select their own memory/loading. Sliding GREAT selects window/step/inner count; EW GREAT matches the shared Bingham beta and selects step/inner count.
stationary_configuration.great_ew_weights: Complex EW GREAT receives sqrt(eta_j/eta_initial)*u_j, eta_j=tau2_j/[sigma2_j*(sigma2_j+tau2_j)]. Its covariance matches the uncentered Bingham statistic up to the fixed positive factor eta_initial under the uniform prior. Fixed-variance data are unchanged; raw sliding-window GREAT retains the original residual objective.
stationary_configuration.variance_convention: Proper-complex covariance sigma2*I; real/imaginary component variances sigma2/2. Unit steering signatures give total interference power tau2.
stationary_configuration.motion: Identity transport for all primary unknown-motion comparisons. Baseline half-power desired/interference overlap is held exactly fixed across dimensions.
stationary_configuration.numerical_scope: Native complex rank-one means and normalizers only; no higher-rank, tail, interval or second-moment accuracy is inferred from these mean flags.
stationary_configuration.scale_information: This performance cohort conditions on the generating variances at correction/action time as a calibrated reference. The separate causal variance-learning cohort never receives future generating scales.
stationary_configuration.block_budget: Supplementary cadence/constant-state-block experiment uses 64 independent test episodes per motion at n=32,T=64. Primary stationary/moving performance cohorts retain 256. This smaller block cohort was selected from operation counts/native-mean preflight before any block task outcomes.
stationary_configuration.precision: Paper plan: 64 validation and 256 independent test episodes per primary cohort; all paired pointwise 95% intervals and achieved SEs retained. Broad grids are exploratory without multiplicity correction.

stationary_general_gate.scope: Complete original general notebook and all current regressions. Final stage-specific scientific and statistical limitations are retained independently of algebra/test success.

limitations: Loading coefficients are checked against source procedure and allowed range; the full validation holdout matrices are not retained, so continuous minimization is not independently rerun.
Native posterior moments are checked through frozen general validation and stored error bounds; this audit performs no posterior integration or inference.

stationary_revised_quantities.scope: Independent raw-record and algebraic verification only; no new simulation, selection, fit or posterior integration.

historical_gate.scope: Original certificate and archived generating sources; not a current-run authorization.

stationary_design.loading_audit_scope: Measured-selection source procedure and coefficient range; complete validation holdout matrices are not retained, so no continuous fit is rerun.

limitations: The full per-time contact results at all 48 action times are not retained for every simulation; the saved episode_average records and producer source establish the requested time averaging. These aggregate records independently satisfy the Frobenius identity and paired-summary checks.

Contact evaluation uses a fixed rotated orthonormal query basis rather than the literal canonical basis; the three-query average equals v0^2||D-P||_F^2/3 and therefore equals the revised definition for any measured rotation. No metric rescaling is needed.
The audit does not recompute Bingham normalizers or predictive densities; it verifies the saved normalized prequential_score and its source definition.

stationary_native_geometry.scope: Direct saved-array algebra only; no inference, fitting, simulation, density normalization or display rotation is introduced.

contact_cell_preservation.scope: Provenance metadata only; no contact code or outputs executed or changed.

monte_carlo_bands.scope: Independent recalculation of every interval used by displayed task/adaptation/calibration plots in the two notebooks; plotting/numerical arrays unchanged.

monte_carlo_bands.postprocessing: Only the declared sample quantiles, Student-t intervals, or exact binomial intervals; no smoothing, rescaling, minimum display width, or added jitter in shaded bands.
monte_carlo_bands.important_distinction: Repeated simulation trials produce empirical spread and uncertainty in aggregate means/coverage; these bands are not posterior credible tubes or Monte Carlo integration error. Finite integration error is checked separately.

monte_carlo_bands.reporting_scope: Adaptation values are pre-update estimates at sparse reporting times, not a dense trajectory between reports.

beamforming.clock: The displayed clock is the stored integer measurement index t; time_s=(t-1)*dt is retained only for checking the original records.
beamforming.displayed_event_marker: Measurement 129, the first measurement using the changed generating variance; the true step uses where=post.
beamforming.source: Noise variance is multiplied by four at zero-based index T//2 in the saved-study generator; no stream is regenerated here.
beamforming.interpretation: Displayed estimates are pre-correction checkpoint values. Connecting segments are not additional measurements or a reconstruction of scale updates between checkpoints.

contact.clock: The adaptation table uses time_s=(t-1)*dt, with the first observation at zero.
contact.displayed_event_marker: First reporting checkpoint with changed generating variance; not the exact physical change time.
contact.source: Noise variance is multiplied by four at zero-based index T//2 in the saved-study generator; no stream is regenerated here.
contact.interpretation: Displayed estimates are pre-correction checkpoint values. Connecting segments are not additional measurements or a reconstruction of scale updates between checkpoints.
